name: NASA Black Marble
notes: VNP46A4 annual BRDF-adjusted nightlights ~500 m. THE SOURCE demographics.nightlights ACTUALLY USES. ArchiveSet 5200 (not 5000). Subdataset AllAngle_Composite_Snow_Free. v2.0 stores radiance as float so gas flares above 6553.5 stop saturating. No commercial restriction - chosen over Google Earth Engine whose free tier is noncommercial only

name: Impact Observatory
notes: 10 m annual LULC 9-class from Sentinel-2. Commercial use permitted with attribution. ANNUAL unlike ESA WorldCover which stopped at 2021. Kept ALONGSIDE WorldCover which has 11 classes incl mangroves. NOT temporally consistent - yearly snapshots only
column9: change layer is pending_review. etl_29 inserts this row at runtime so the live database had it before this catalogue did

name: Digital Earth Africa
notes: Built the gm_s2_annual Sentinel-2 geomedian that satellite.ndvi is computed from. NDVI previously attributed to the bare Sentinel-2 row which understates whose product it is. Their own spec warns the Landsat NDVI climatology is unreliable over equatorial Africa which is why the Sentinel-2 geomedian was chosen
